title: Scope changes
description: Review extra work before changing the project.
createHint: Describe the change. Attached files are shared with the project client.
error: Could not load requests. Refresh to try again.
noClient: Assign a client to the project before requesting a scope change.
emptyHint: Record additional work here to agree on hours, price and deadlines before applying it.
clientChanged: The project client has changed. This request cannot be approved or applied; cancel it and create a new request.
taskCreated: A private task was created for the team.
billingNote: This commercial draft preserves the approved amount and currency. It is not an issued invoice and triggers no payment. Review it before issuing an invoice through your billing process.
flowNote: Every estimate has a version. Approval applies only to that version. Application requires a separate review, and the original budget remains unchanged.
fileNote: Up to 5 files. Uploads remain in the client’s Media Center even if removed from this request.
uploadError: The upload failed. Try again before submitting.
revisionNote: Sending creates a new version for client approval. Leave the deadline empty to keep the current date.
applicationNote: Select the effects to apply. This operation is recorded once for the approved version.
createTask: Create a private task with the approved hours and deadline
applyDate: Apply the approved deadline to the project
confirmApproval: I reviewed the hours, price, currency and deadline for this version.
confirmApplication: I reviewed the selected effects and confirm their application.
saveError: Could not save. Refresh the request and review its current version before trying again.
forbidden: You do not have permission to manage scope changes.

errors.VERSION_CHANGED: The estimate changed. Close this window and review the latest version.
errors.DEADLINE_CHANGED: The project dates changed. Close this window and review the current schedule before applying a deadline.
errors.CLIENT_CHANGED: The project client changed. Cancel this request and create another for the current client.
errors.INVALID_STATE: The request changed state. Close this window and refresh.
errors.INVALID_FILES: An attachment is no longer available for this project and client.
errors.FINANCIAL_ACCESS_REQUIRED: Only users with financial access can publish estimates or apply approved changes.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check the hours, amount, currency, dates and required fields.
errors.ALREADY_APPLIED: This version was already applied with different options. Refresh to see the recorded result.
